feature.action_mapping_note: Canonical actions are backed by the simulator's advertised supported-action surface.

intent.user_goal: Use Test Data Source as part of a realistic IntelliJ IDEA workflow.
intent.transcript_requirement: Treat this as available only when the transcript/video requires the visible capability described here.
intent.when_to_use: Use this file when transcript actions, spoken UI references, or expected visible results correspond to Test Data Source.
intent.when_not_to_use: Do not substitute this feature for a different control merely because the concepts are related.

ui_contract.required_visibility: A lesson using this capability must produce a visible software-owned UI state.
ui_contract.before_state: The simulator starts from the package baseline plus prior cumulative actions.
ui_contract.interaction: Invoke one of the canonical actions with data matching its engine handler.
ui_contract.after_state: The software must visibly reflect the result of the canonical action; hidden JavaScript state alone is insufficient.
ui_contract.focus_and_scroll: Keep the active control/result visible without replay shaking.
ui_contract.highlight_rule: Highlight only the precise control, row, field, tab, code line, command, or result relevant to this feature; never the whole application surface.
ui_contract.explanation_rule: Explanation UI is parent-owned and global; this feature must not create a competing explanation card.

input_contract.parameters: Read the exact engine handler for the selected canonical action before creating lesson action.data. Do not invent parameters.
input_contract.destructive_note: No destructive semantics are inferred from the canonical action name.

state_contract.user_preferences: User-controlled layout/theme/persistent preferences must not be overwritten by lesson replay unless explicitly changed.

transcript_matching.decision_rule: Match the visible interaction and expected UI result, then confirm the canonical engine action.

authoring_steps: Confirm the transcript actually uses this visible feature.
Read this feature file rather than relying only on AI_CAPABILITY_INDEX.json.
Inspect the matching engine handler for required action.data.
Do not invent an action when preferred_actions is empty.
Ensure the lesson visibly changes or focuses the expected UI.
Validate deterministic direct-jump replay from a clean load.
lesson_authoring.missing_feature_rule: If transcript behavior exceeds this file and no engine action/UI supports it, upgrade the master simulator before building the lesson.

replay_and_quality.visual_fidelity_note: Catalog presence proves registered/action coverage, not pixel-perfect visual fidelity.

regression_expectations: Feature file remains present while capability/action remains supported.
Canonical actions remain declared by the simulator.
Feature remains software-owned rather than implemented in app.js.

update_when: capability is split into more precise sub-features
transcript audits discover a missing visible state
maintenance.generated_baseline_note: Detailed baseline generated from registered capability and engine action surfaces; future manual enrichment is allowed.
